text:
emma: FYI after rolling RBAC canary to 5 tenants were getting a small but consistent batch of SCIM failures (403) tied to assertion decrypt. samples below.

rishi: paste logs? which tenants?

emma: two tenants are Azure AD B2B and one is Okta SP-initiated. sample: 
```
2026-04-01T08:12:01Z scim-provisioner ERROR user=svc_emma@example.com err="kms:decrypt: jwe_compact_unexpected" details="compact=\"eyJhbGciOiJkaXIiLCJlbmMiOiJBMTI4R0NNIn0..CIPHERTEXT..TAG\""
http 403 {"error":"decrypt_failed","key_arn":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/tenant-xyz"}
```

tay: alg=dir + enc=A128GCM in the compact JWE. our parser expects RSA-OAEP with wrapped cek.

oncall: any KMS rotations recently?

kms-bot: key/tenant-xyz rotated at 3712341000 supported_algorithms=["RSA-OAEP","RSA-OAEP-256"]

rishi: rotation doesn't explain alg=dir. sounds like tenant IdP changed to direct symmetric JWE compact serialization. we don't have tenant symmetric key so can't decrypt.

emma: mitigation suggestion: halt RBAC canary role writes that trigger provisioning, flip off verbose assertion dumps, and enqueue failed ops for later replay. also notify CS for impacted tenants.

tay: agree. quick patch: parser should detect compact JWE with alg=="dir" and return a clear error string "jwe-direct-unsupported" so CS can see a concise reason. also emit metric scim.decrypt.fail_reason:jwe_direct.

oncall: paused canary and set masked-logging flag in prod (no full assertions in logs). created incident https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-jwe-compact.

rishi: longer term options: ask tenants to switch to RSA-OAEP assertion encryption; offer a customer-managed-key integration for tenants that want to stay on direct symmetric encryption; or add a compatibility shim but that has cryptographic and compliance footprint so needs legal+security review.

emma: opened Okta/Azure support cases and added tenant config screenshots to the incident. leaving notes for postmortem and runbook update (include JWE compact vs JSON serialization explanation).

tay: unit tests to add: compact-jwe-dir fixture, ensure masked logging on errors, and metric alerting when rate>3% for 10m.

emma: thanks all. keeping thread as incident notes. :white_check_mark:
